Server rules

Breaking rules can lead to a mute, kick, or ban. By joining, you agree to follow them.

1

Be respectful

Treat everyone kindly. No harassment, hate speech, discrimination or toxic behavior.

2

No cheating

Hacked clients, x-ray, auto-clickers and any unfair advantage are not allowed.

3

No griefing or stealing

Do not destroy, steal from or modify other players' builds. Claim your land.

4

Keep chat clean

No spam, advertising, excessive caps or inappropriate content in chat.

5

No exploits

Do not abuse bugs or glitches. Report them to staff instead.

6

No lag machines

Avoid massive redstone clocks, mob farms or entity counts that harm server performance.

7

Follow staff

Staff decisions are final. If you disagree, calmly open a ticket on Discord.

8

Use common sense

If you wonder whether something is allowed, ask staff before you do it.

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about joining, ranks and support.

How do I join the server?
Open Minecraft, go to Multiplayer, choose Add Server and enter mangosmp.falix.gg.
Which Minecraft version do I need?
Use the latest Java Edition release for the best experience. Check the Discord announcements for the exact supported versions.
Can Bedrock players join?
Yes, if cross-play is enabled on the server. Use the same IP. If it does not connect, ask staff on Discord.
Is the server pay-to-win?
No. Ranks add cosmetics and convenience only.
How do I get a rank after buying?
Open a ticket on Discord with your username. Staff will apply it as soon as possible.
How do I report a player or bug?
Open a ticket on Discord or message an online staff member in game.
The server shows offline. What now?
Check the status on the home page, then ask in Discord. We will post updates if there is maintenance.

Still stuck? Ask the community.

Join our Discord

MangoSMP Server Policy

These rules keep MangoSMP safe, fair and fun. By playing on the server you agree to follow them.

On this page
  1. General Rules
  2. Gameplay Rules
  3. Chat Rules
  4. Staff Rules
  5. Punishments
  6. Important Information

01General Rules

  • Respect all players and staff.
  • No harassment, hate speech or bullying.
  • No spam or advertising.
  • No inappropriate usernames or skins.
  • Follow staff instructions.

02Gameplay Rules

  • No hacking or unfair modifications.
  • No exploiting bugs or glitches. Report them to staff instead.
  • No duping or abusing game exploits.
  • No stealing or griefing where prohibited.
  • No inappropriate PvP behavior.

03Chat Rules

  • No excessive caps or spam.
  • No threats or harassment.
  • No malicious links.
  • Keep chat respectful.

04Staff Rules

  • Do not impersonate staff.
  • Do not abuse staff reports.
  • Report rule violations with evidence, such as screenshots or video, so staff can review them properly.

05Punishments

Depending on the severity and history of a violation, staff may apply one of the following:

  • Verbal warning.
  • Warning.
  • Temporary mute or ban.
  • Permanent ban for serious or repeated violations.

06Important Information

  • Rules may be updated from time to time.
  • Players are responsible for following the latest rules.
  • Staff decisions should follow fair moderation procedures. If you believe a decision was a mistake, contact us through a Discord support ticket.

Last updated: November 2026. Questions? Contact us on Discord.

MangoSMP Refund Policy

Please read this policy before buying anything from the MangoSMP store.

On this page
  1. Digital Purchases
  2. Refund Eligibility
  3. Chargebacks
  4. Purchase Responsibility
  5. Support
  6. Policy Updates

01Digital Purchases

All ranks, keys, shards, crates, cosmetics and other virtual items sold by MangoSMP are digital products.

02Refund Eligibility

  • Purchases are generally non-refundable after successful delivery, subject to any rights you have under applicable consumer law.
  • Contact support if an item was not delivered.
  • Duplicate charges and verified billing errors will be investigated.
  • Refund requests involving unauthorized transactions will be reviewed.

03Chargebacks

Please contact MangoSMP support before opening a payment dispute so we can investigate and try to resolve the issue.

04Purchase Responsibility

Check your Minecraft username and selected product carefully before purchasing.

05Support

All purchase-related issues must be submitted through the official MangoSMP Discord support ticket system.

06Policy Updates

MangoSMP may update this policy when necessary.

Last updated: November 2026. Questions? Contact us on Discord.

Terms & Conditions

Please read these terms before buying from the MangoSMP store or playing on the server.

On this page
  1. Acceptance
  2. Products and Delivery
  3. Orders and Payment
  4. Your Responsibilities
  5. Conduct
  6. Refunds and Disputes
  7. Changes
  8. Contact

01Acceptance

By using the MangoSMP website or store, or by playing on the server, you agree to these terms, the Server Policy and the Refund Policy.

02Products and Delivery

Ranks, keys and other store items are digital items for use on MangoSMP.

  • Items are delivered in-game to the Minecraft username entered at checkout.
  • Delivery happens after staff verify your payment. We aim to deliver as soon as possible.
  • If an item is missing, contact support through a Discord ticket with your order code.

03Orders and Payment

  • Prices are shown in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and may change. Your order uses the price shown when you placed it.
  • Placing an order does not complete it. An order counts as paid only after staff verify your payment.
  • Available payment methods and instructions are shown at checkout.

04Your Responsibilities

  • Check your Minecraft username and selected products before ordering.
  • Provide accurate information and keep your order code private.

05Conduct

Buying from the store does not exempt you from the Server Policy.

06Refunds and Disputes

Refunds are handled under the Refund Policy. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under applicable consumer law. Please contact support before opening a payment dispute.

07Changes

MangoSMP may update products, prices, the server and these terms when necessary. The latest version on this page applies.

08Contact

For any question about these terms or your order, open a ticket in the MangoSMP Discord.

Last updated: November 2026. Questions? Contact us on Discord.
